title: Clipperton Rock (1899).jpg
author: after a photograph by John T. Arundel
description: from Alexander Agassiz (1899). "The Fiji Islands and Coral Reefs" Bulletin of the Museum of Comparative Zoology, Vol. 33, p. 106. Admiral Wharton has given a most interesting sketch of Clipperton Atoll, in which he confirms the trachytic nature of the "Rock" of Clipperton, as determined by Professor Wolff from specimens collected by Mr. Jensen and kindly sent me by Professor Davidson.
